Record Class ExplorationConfig

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
fosalgo.pheroswarm.ExplorationConfig
Record Components:
maxSteps - maximum simulation steps, from 1 to 1,000,000
stallLimit - maximum consecutive steps without movement, from 1 to maxSteps
lambda - nonnegative weight of the digital pheromone penalty; zero selects M0
rho - pheromone fraction evaporated per step, between 0 and 1
deposit - nonnegative amount of pheromone deposited at a successful move destination
recovery - whether frontier exhaustion and alternate-move recovery are enabled
traceFile - destination for the diagnostic CSV, or an empty string to disable export
traceLast - maximum number of trailing steps to export; zero writes the full trace
public record ExplorationConfig(int maxSteps, int stallLimit, double lambda, double rho, double deposit, boolean recovery, String traceFile, int traceLast) extends Record
Stores validated parameters for one simulation run.

Use defaults() for the built-in settings or fromSystemProperties() for JVM overrides.

  • Constructor Details

    • ExplorationConfig

      public ExplorationConfig(int maxSteps, int stallLimit, double lambda, double rho, double deposit, boolean recovery, String traceFile, int traceLast)
      Creates a configuration and validates the parameter ranges.
      Parameters:
      maxSteps - maximum simulation steps, from 1 to 1,000,000
      stallLimit - maximum consecutive steps without movement, from 1 to maxSteps
      lambda - nonnegative weight of the digital pheromone penalty; zero selects M0
      rho - pheromone fraction evaporated per step, between 0 and 1
      deposit - nonnegative amount of pheromone deposited at a successful move destination
      recovery - whether frontier exhaustion and alternate-move recovery are enabled
      traceFile - destination for the diagnostic CSV, or an empty string to disable export
      traceLast - maximum number of trailing steps to export; zero writes the full trace
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a numeric parameter is outside its permitted range
